messages.subject: The fifth mug
messages.body: Relief lander on the camera. The fifth mug is off its clip and on the table. I did not polish it this morning. Again.

messages.subject: Five on the roster
messages.body: Inner airlock opened on two agreeing checks. The Safe Room board now has five name tokens. Commander Ferreira takes the first watch; please show her the corridor routes and the hand-light locker.

messages.subject: Her mug
messages.body: Ferreira carried her own mug to the table before she unpacked anything else. Roster and watch rota are updated for five.

messages.subject: An uneventful watch
messages.body: The commander's first watch was quiet: labels checked, times written, readings waited for. Rafi logged the sealed relay-controller crate by serial. It stays packed.

messages.subject: A document sleeve
messages.body: I have left a sealed document sleeve on my shelf. On the 14th I will bring it to the table. Read it with me before you ask me what I remember.

messages.subject: The order we left in
messages.body: Four records rebuilt in order from timestamps and signatures: relay fault, greenhouse service note, evacuation order, ascent manifest. No accusations, only sequence. Mei wants to set the frozen-tray photograph beside them.

messages.subject: The photograph
messages.body: Bring the frozen-tray photograph to the table. I want to read the growth sheet with it, not my old guesses.

messages.subject: Revised caption
messages.body: I have changed the caption. Expedition Zero's trays held young seedlings with curled leaves. They had not flowered. Alo's bloom is still the first. I would rather be accurate than flattered.

messages.subject: Ferreira was watching
messages.body: The commander watched Mei change the caption and did not say anything. I think that was a good sign? Hard to tell with commanders.

messages.subject: Kept visible
messages.body: We did not settle the disagreement, and that is fine. It stays on the table, with the record the commander left there. Kai is comparing the old relay diagram with the new controller next.

messages.subject: What I didn't say
messages.body: Thank you for asking before you guessed. I should have told you sooner. The records stay on the table; read them as they are.

messages.subject: Not interchangeable
messages.body: Old relay diagram versus the new controller's service card: similar housings, different connectors. The spare stays packed, and the uplink we have is working normally. Repair plan written without needing Earth.

messages.subject: Tonight: impact watch
messages.body: Night observation starts soon. Small meteoroids strike the Moon and make brief flashes. With no air, there are no streaks. Log candidates frame by frame; one sighting is not enough.

messages.subject: Observation log
messages.body: Candidates logged by frame. One stayed at the same detector spot across several frames: that is the camera, not the Moon. Keep the observation clock running into maintenance.

messages.subject: No shooting stars
messages.body: No streaks, no whoosh. Just tiny flashes, enlarged. Still the coolest thing I have seen on a screen.

messages.subject: Two observations, two causes
messages.body: Maintenance done. Panel output below its reference and a small leak on an isolated garden branch: separate observations, separate fixes. The observation report is complete and on the evidence table.

messages.subject: Dust has a cost
messages.body: Fine dust on panels lowers their output a little at a time. Compare against a reference reading before deciding what is wrong.

messages.subject: Records finish it
messages.body: An initial leads us. A record finishes it.

messages.subject: Different dates
messages.body: Tonight's flashes and the old damage report stay side by side, with their different dates. A hazard explains why we watch; it does not prove what broke a relay years ago. Rao is calling with a signed page.

messages.subject: A name, with permission
messages.body: Aurora, Earth desk. The signed page is hers and the permission note is in the packet. N.R. is Dr. Noor Rahman, botanist, the person who left the seeds. She has read your transmitted reports.

messages.subject: Journal updated
messages.body: The seed packet's initial now reads Dr. Noor Rahman: botanist, Expedition Zero. She returned to Bangladesh and founded Last Light Academy.

messages.subject: Invitation sent
messages.body: Delivered. No immediate reply, which is right: it was an invitation, not an answer owed. The graphs went as attachments, as Amara said.

messages.subject: Waiting
messages.body: I checked the inbox three times. Rafi says that is two more than useful.

messages.subject: Thank you for asking
messages.body: Thank you for asking. I would like to see what you grow next.

messages.subject: One more seed
messages.body: One cotton specimen is cleared from quarantine for the indoor reference bay, and Tara's name stays on the frame. A new seed, not the old flower returning. Dated care into January, same as before.

messages.subject: Marker tape
messages.body: I taped markers along the guide-light circuit so we can find each segment in the dark. Ferreira says the eclipse is coming. I have more tape.
